name: Tractor with Log Loader
instructions: omr/instructions/8049-1-1.pdf and omr/instructions/8049-1-2.pdf (the tractor and its log trailer; book 2 pages 36-37 show every function; pages 38 on rebuild it with the 8293 Power Functions set, which the file doesn't)

functions.does: The round yellow knob on the cab roof steers the front wheels: its upright axle comes down through the cab to a knob gear, which turns a long axle forward to a gear that slides the steering rack across the front axle.
functions.source: book: book 1 steps 8 (rack), 12-18 (long axle, knob gears and the upright axle with its knob); how it's worked inferred, as the book draws no arrow for it

functions.does: The trailer hangs on the tractor's hitch by a single pin, so the tractor swings on it to steer the trailer round corners.
functions.source: book: book 2 step 20 and page 11 (trailer hitched on); inferred: that it's meant to swing

functions.does: The black gear at the back of the trailer slews the crane: a long axle under the trailer bed carries its turn forward to a bevel gear, which turns a 20-tooth bevel gear on an upright axle, whose 8-tooth gear drives the turntable under the crane.
functions.source: book: book 1 pages 51-56 (bevel gears, upright axle and long axle; page 56 arrows show the knob turning the bevel gears); book 2 page 37 (top: the knob turning and the crane slewing)

functions.does: The hand pump on the trailer, with the left valve set, works the cylinder in the crane's red post, raising or lowering the boom on its pivot at the top of the post.
functions.source: book: book 2 page 36 (left column: the valve lever up, the pump pushed, the boom rising), book 2 steps 26-29 (post, cylinder and boom); inferred: which valve is which, read from the drawing
functions.note: worked in the set by pumping p220 2797c02 with the valve p290 47223a or p291 47223a set; the cylinder's rod stands in as the control

functions.does: The hand pump, with the right valve set one way or the other, works the cylinder on top of the boom, swinging the outer arm with the grab down or up.
functions.source: book: book 2 page 36 (middle and right columns: the other valve lever down or up, the pump pushed, the outer arm swinging down or up), book 2 steps 28-30
functions.note: worked in the set by pumping p220 2797c02 with the other valve set; the cylinder's rod stands in as the control

functions.does: The black gear on the grab opens and closes its two jaws: it turns a worm, which turns an 8-tooth gear on one jaw's axle, and two 16-tooth gears mesh between the jaws so they swing together.
functions.source: book: book 2 grab sub-steps 1-15 on pages 28-32 (arrows on pages 31 show the jaws swinging), page 37 (bottom: the knob turning and the jaws closing)

functions.does: The grab hangs from the end of the outer arm on two pivots, so it swings and stays hanging straight down as the arm moves.
functions.skip: it only hangs straight under gravity

functions.does: The tractor's four wheels and the trailer's four wheels roll freely.
